name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Either London goes with 1581 or Magnus goes with 1531.
Anatoly, Mikhail, and Vera go with Italian, Sicilian, and 1581, in some order.
If Magnus goes with Pirc, then all of 1631 goes with Garry, 1631 does not go with London, and someone in the King's-Pawn Camp goes with Vera.
Magnus goes with exactly one of London, Pirc, or 1531.
The Caro-Kann player's rating is higher than both Mikhail and the Pirc player.
At least three of Garry, Magnus, Mikhail, and the 1581-rated player belong to the King's-Pawn Camp.
The Italian player's rating is lower than both Anatoly and the Caro-Kann player.
